summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I did for this plan:** read-only audit of the full chain — `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, `handlers.ts`, `server.ts` middleware, `db/auth.ts` (sessions), `client/src/hooks/useAuth.tsx`, `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`. No files edited.  ### What the audit found (surprising) Every piece of the chain I read looks *correctly* wired, contrary to the ticket's working theory: - `watchlists`/`watchlist_items` schema has a mandatory `user_id`/`watchlist_id` FK — no anonymous/default row possible. - Watchl
